scripts.predev: npm run -s schema && npm run -s wasm
scripts.prebuild: npm run -s schema && npm run -s wasm
scripts.server: npm run -s schema && npm run -s wasm && wrangler dev --config server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.wasm: cargo build -q -p world-wasm -p land-wasm -p movement-wasm -p room-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.mkdirSync('client/public',{recursive:true});for(const name of ['world','land','movement','room'])fs.copyFileSync('target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/'+name+'_wasm.wasm','client/public/'+name+'.wasm')"
scripts.types: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json
